title: search.signal
description: The one inbound door for promotion and popularity (spec §14). Idempotent by event id, last writer wins by event position. Who is allowed to emit it is a product decision (a billing entitlement, an editorial tool) that lives outside this module: stapel-search owns the field and the audit row, not the policy. Adding tiers or a promo marketplace later is a new emitter, not a redesign of the index.

boost.description: Relevance boost, clamped to [-1.0, 5.0]. Applies ONLY under sort=relevance.

promoted.description: DSA Art. 26 marker, serialized on every result item.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601; after it the beat drops promoted and boost.
